questions.prompt: In a nested loop, which loop does break exit?
choices: Only the innermost one it is in
questions.explain: break affects just the loop containing it, which surprises people the first time they nest loops.

questions.prompt: What does a loop's else clause do?
choices: Runs when the loop body fails
Runs when the loop finished without hitting a break
questions.explain: It is genuinely useful for search loops: the else runs when you got all the way through and found nothing.
